method.timed: Each binary runs a new server per mode. Native and combined modes replay the same 15 edits. The gate uses the median of body edits 2 through 6, measured at matching edited-document version diagnostic receipt.
method.oracle: For each state, the hover response and accumulated diagnostic content match exactly across analyses and binaries. The state containing an introduced error must report it, and repair must clear it.
method.comparison: Four host warm-up passes and six independent blocks with alternating order. Each block measures both an A/A noise pair and an A/B pair. Paired sign intervals and host power, thermal and swap conditions decide the gate.
method.otherMeasurements: Observational A/B medians, including startup through first hover, structural and repaired edits, and the highest sampled kernel lifetime physical footprint in bytes.
method.startup: The server process is new. The OS file cache and input artifacts may be warm.
method.cachesUnlimited: Semantic budget limits disabled in both builds during the workload. Experiments are enabled only in the designated arms.
